review_notes: Resolve an example whose local label differs from its registered component name. The local example label is substituted for the reference target value. Resolve each mapping value while preserving its local example label. Original F2P/P2P unchanged. Baseline diagnostic failure is expected task reproduction, not a policy error. Source imports asserted against the workspace before and after the repair.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'src/apispec/core.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('apispec.core')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from apispec import APISpec
spec=APISpec(title='demo',version='1',openapi_version='3.0.3')
spec.components.example('Canonical',component={'value':3})
value={'examples':{'display':'Canonical'}}
spec.components._resolve_examples(value)
print('example_reference',value)
assert value=={'examples':{'display':{'$ref':'#/components/examples/Canonical'}}}

PYREPLAY
